subject: design/code-gate-mirror
statement: The check list is **explicit per-repo config** (design-brainstorm:code-gate-mirror-tech-design#D-4). The `code-gate` verb reads the repo's code-gate config block, runs each listed check through the shared runner, and emits one aggregate verdict. There is no gate-time stack detection and no built-in default list — the gate runs exactly what the config declares. Repo setup (`pyxis init`) may *scaffold* a starter list into the config, but that is editable, visible content the author owns, never a fallback the verb reaches for on its own.
